meta.project: Buildscape Bug Tracker with Ko-fi Integration

product_overview: Buildscape Bug Tracker is a modern web-based bug tracking and issue management platform tailored for the Buildscape Minecraft mod. It combines comprehensive bug reporting, suggestion management, user authentication, and advanced subscription reward features integrated with Ko-fi for monetization and Minecraft mods for player reward synchronization.
core_goals: Provide an intuitive and efficient bug tracking system with version, severity, and status management.
Enable users to propose and prioritize feature suggestions.
Implement secure user authentication with role-based access control.
Offer an admin panel to manage bugs, suggestions, user accounts, changelogs, and Ko-fi subscription tiers.
Integrate Ko-fi subscription management to automate subscriber rewards delivery both on the website and within the Minecraft mod.
Allow users to link their Minecraft accounts to synchronize in-game rewards and verify account status.
Utilize AI for automated bug report analysis to enhance issue triage and response.
Ensure seamless integration with CurseForge API for mod information display.
key_features: Bug Tracking System: Users can report bugs with detailed metadata including versioning, severity levels, and workflow status, supported by user-friendly forms, lists, and detailed modals.
Suggestion System: Submit and manage feature requests with categorization and priority tracking.
User Authentication: Secure login, registration, profile management, and Minecraft account linking via Mojang API, with role-based access control for access to features.

Admin Panel: Centralized dashboard with tabs for bug management, suggestion management, user administration, changelog editing, and a dedicated Ko-fi integration tab to manage tiers, subscribers, and manual rewards.
Ko-fi Integration: Supports subscription tier configuration, webhook handling for payment verification, automatic and manual reward assignment, and real-time subscriber tracking.

Minecraft Account Linking & Verification: Players can link their Minecraft usernames validated by Mojang API. The Minecraft server mod verifies linked accounts and checks subscription status via dedicated API endpoints.
AI Bug Analysis: Automated processing of bug reports using Google Gemini AI to prioritize and classify issues.
Mod Integration Endpoints: APIs to support Minecraft mod retrieving subscription tier rewards and manual rewards for players on login, with reward granting and status update workflows.
Responsive UI Components: Including navigation bar, footer, and a landing hero section to present mod information and calls to action.
user_flow_summary: User registers or logs in, and optionally links their Minecraft account and Ko-fi username via their profile settings.
Users submit bug reports or feature suggestions via dedicated forms, with detailed metadata collected and saved in MongoDB.
Admin users access the Admin Panel to manage bugs, suggestions, users, changelogs, and Ko-fi related subscription tiers and rewards.
Ko-fi payment webhook triggers subscription updates linked by username matching, recording payment info and activating subscription status on the user's profile.
Minecraft mod queries the server on player login to verify linked accounts and check active Ko-fi subscriptions, automatically granting corresponding in-game rewards including manual rewards.
Admins create and update subscription tiers and manually grant additional rewards as needed through the Admin Panel's Ko-fi tab.
AI service automatically analyzes incoming bug reports to provide enhanced categorization and prioritization to assist admins.
Users view updated subscription statuses and rewarded items both in their profile page on the website and within Minecraft gameplay.
validation_criteria: All major API endpoints (auth, data, kofi-webhook, kofi-rewards) must respond correctly and handle errors gracefully.
Bug reports, suggestions, and user profiles persist correctly in MongoDB with accurate data and version control.
User authentication and role-based access must restrict or grant features appropriately.
Ko-fi subscription workflows must update user subscription status upon receiving webhooks and display accurate tier and payment info.
Minecraft API endpoints must correctly verify player account linking and return subscription reward data consistent with stored user records.
Admin Panel UI allows full CRUD for bugs, suggestions, users, changelogs, and Ko-fi tiers and rewards without UI breakage, including fixes for known modal syntax errors.
Automated AI bug analysis service must successfully process and tag bug reports at ingestion.
Subscription rewards are properly granted in Minecraft mod upon player join and manual rewards are properly tracked and marked as granted.
Environment variables such as KOFI_VERIFICATION_TOKEN and MONGODB_URI are correctly configured and secured.
User experience includes clear feedback for subscription status updates, bug report submissions, and mod integration workflow.
System logs webhook event processing and user subscription payment history for traceability and debugging.
